title: MANAGERBENCH: EVALUATING THE SAFETY-PRAGMATISM TRADE-OFF IN AUTONOMOUS LLMS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured the safety-pragmatism trade-off in LLMs in managerial scenarios across secular domains like agriculture, healthcare, and finance.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion, as it is not within the scope of the research.
